title: Borrow scan computation
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be any valid input-head position, and let $\mathrm{out}$ and $u$ be Boolean words. For every pair of Boolean words $\mathrm{pre},u$ used as the work-tape prefix and suffix, starting with the borrow-phase machine in its initial borrow state, its work head at cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$, and tape contents $\mathrm{pre}\,u$, after $\beta(u)+1$ steps it is in the borrow-result state carrying the success flag of the fixed-width decrement of $u$. Its work head is at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+\beta(u)-1$, its tape contains $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by the decremented word, and its input position and output word remain $p$ and $\mathrm{out}$, respectively; here $\beta(u)$ is the number of initial zero bits of $u$.
replaced: For every counter word $u$ and every prefix $p$: starting in the borrow state with work head at cell $|p|$ over the word $p\,u$, exactly $\beta + 1$ steps of the countdown emitter, where $\beta$ is the borrow position of $u$, reach the rewind state carrying the success flag of the decrement of $u$, with the work tape now holding $p$ followed by the decremented word.
